in_sanskrit.name: Ataur
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the cattle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ataur एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ataur is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘asva’, meaning horse or cattle. The name Ataur is believed to be the lord of cattle and is often used as a name for a protector or a provider. In Hindu mythology, Ataur is associated with the god Indra, who is the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. As a protector and provider, Indra is believed to look after the cattle and the agricultural produce.
